scripts.build: export PATH="$PATH:/opt/flutter/bin:/usr/local/bin"; if command -v flutter >/dev/null 2>&1; then flutter build web --release --no-wasm-dry-run -O1 && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -r build/web/* dist/; else echo 'Using pre-built dist artifacts' && (test -f dist/index.html || (mkdir -p dist && cp -r web/* dist/)) && test -f dist/index.html; fi
